_comment: VQA-RAD. Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Source: VQA_RAD Dataset Public.json read with pandas (2,248 questions). The table has one row per question, so rows is the question count (D-03). phrase_type test_freeform and test_para (451 questions) are the test set, the others are train. The source has no patient ID, so patient_id is the image name. The paper made the test set on the same images: 202 of the 203 test images also have train questions.
